text: Core courses C Language Program Design, Principle of Computer Make-Up, Operation System, Data Structure, Principle of Network, Analysis of Communication Protocol, Network Programming, Principle of Database, Network Management and Maintenance, Information Security and Network Security. Objective This objective is to train students to be high-quality technical personnel working, after graduation, in scientific research departments, schools, enterprises, technical units or administrative service divisions to be engaged in computer teaching, research or application. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Engineering is granted.
